output-file: "Survey-2026-Employee"

```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
source("source_qmd.R")
source_qmd("1-functions.qmd")
source_qmd("2-dict.qmd")
source_qmd("3-data.qmd")
```

## Employee

### Demographics

:::::::::: panel-tabset
#### Gender

```{r}
#| label: demog-gen

employee$demog_gen |> 
  top(2, drop_other = FALSE) |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = choices$demog_gen) +
  labs(title = "Gender")
```

#### Age

```{r}
#| label: demog-age

employee$demog_age |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$demog_age |>
      str_replace("Under ", "<")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Age")
```

#### Location

::: panel-tabset
##### 1

```{r}
#| label: demog-locat

employee$demog_locat |>
  other_if(less_than_or_equal_to = 10) |>
  ggplot_1(geom_text_size = 3.4) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "1" = "National /\nPan-Canadian",
      "2" = "AB",
      "3" = "BC",
      "4" = "MB",
      "5" = "NB",
      "6" = "NL",
      "7" = "QC",
      "8" = "NS",
      "9" = "ON",
      "10" = "PE",
      "11" = "SK",
      "12" = "NT",
      "13" = "NU",
      "14" = "YT"
    )
  ) +
  labs(title = "In what province or territory is your work primarily based?")
```

##### 2

```{r}
#| label: demog-locat-live

employee$demog_locat_live |>
  other_if(less_than_or_equal_to = 5) |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("7" = "Québec")) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("demog_locat_live"),
    caption = "Note: This question was introduced in the French translation of the survey."
  ) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
:::

#### Indigenous

```{r}
#| label: demog-indig

employee$demog_indig |>
  mutate(demog_indig = demog_indig |> fct_reorder(-count)) |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = choices$demog_indig) +
  labs(title = "Do you identify as Indigenous (First Nations, Métis, Inuit)?")
```

#### Minority

::: panel-tabset
##### 1

```{r}
#| label: demog-minority

#| fig-height: 4.6

employee$demog_minority |>
  mutate(demog_minority = demog_minority |> fct_reorder(-count)) |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = choices$demog_minority) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("demog_minority") |>
      str_remove("^.*\n"),
    caption = get_question("demog_minority") |>
      str_remove(" \n.*$") |>
      str_wrap()
  ) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

##### 2

```{r}
#| label: demog-popu

# Branching Logic [demog_minority]='1'

employee$demog_popu |>
  mutate(
    demog_popu = demog_popu |>
      fct_reorder(-count) |>
      fct_relevel("12", after = Inf)
  ) |>
  ggplot_1(geom_text_size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$demog_popu |> 
      c("12" = "Other") |> 
      str_split_i("\\.| \\(", 1) |> 
      str_wrap(5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Which population group(s) do you identify with?")
```
:::

  top(3) |>

#### Language

::: panel-tabset
##### 1

```{r}
#| label: demog-lang

employee$demog_lang |> 
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = choices$demog_lang) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("demog_lang") |> 
      str_split_i(" \\(", 1)
  )
```

##### 2

```{r}
#| label: demog-language-work

employee$demog_language_work |> 
  mutate(
    demog_language_work = demog_language_work |> 
      fct_expand("3", after = 2)
  ) |>
  ggplot_1(drop_empty = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = choices$demog_language_work
  ) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("demog_language_work") |> 
      str_replace("language", "language(s)"),
    caption = "Note: This question was introduced in the French translation of the survey."
  ) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

#### Employment

::: panel-tabset
##### 1

```{r}
#| label: demog-employ-typ

employee$demog_employ_typ |>
  mutate(
    demog_employ_typ = demog_employ_typ |> 
      fct_reorder(-count) |> 
      fct_relevel("6", after = Inf)
  ) |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(choices$demog_employ_typ, "6" = "Unemployed") |>
      str_wrap(15)
  ) +
  labs(title = get_question("demog_employ_typ"))
```

##### 2

```{r}
#| label: demog-sector

# Branching Logic [demog_employ_typ]<>'6'

employee$demog_sector |>
  other_if(less_than_or_equal_to = 5, include = "77") |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$demog_sector |>
      str_split_i("\\.|: | \\[| \\(", 1) |>
      str_replace("/", " / ") |>
      str_wrap(15)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("demog_sector"),
    caption = "categories with ≤ 5 respondents grouped into \"Other\""
  )
```

##### 3

```{r}
#| label: demog-commun

# Branching Logic [demog_employ_typ]<>'6'

employee$demog_commun |> 
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$demog_commun |>
      c("4" = "Rural/Northern") |>
      str_split_i(" \\(", 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("demog_commun") |>
      str_wrap(45)
  )
```

##### 4

```{r}
#| label: demog-role

# Branching Logic [demog_employ_typ]<>'6'

employee$demog_role |> 
  mutate(demog_role = demog_role |> fct_reorder(-count)) |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$demog_role |> 
      str_split_i(" \\(", 1) |>
      str_replace_all(" \\&", ",") |>
      str_replace(" / ", "/") |>
      str_wrap(20)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Which of these best describe(s) your role?")
```
